patterns.note: Content sections alternate between a dominant dark background and a lighter, subtle grey background, creating clear visual breaks and hierarchy.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif font for impact, while body text is a lighter weight, creating a strong contrast in visual hierarchy.
A vibrant teal (#67eadd) is consistently used as the primary accent color for call-to-action buttons, links, and key highlights against the dark background.
The hero section features a complex, layered UI illustration that reveals and subtly parallaxes as the user scrolls down, creating a sense of depth and interaction.
Each major content section introduces a key benefit or feature with a prominent heading, followed by a detailed explanation and a rich, illustrative UI screenshot or diagram.

technique_notes: The site employs a dark mode aesthetic with a deep black background and white text, using a bright teal as a primary accent color for interactive elements and highlights.
Call-to-action buttons feature a solid teal background with white text, using subtle rounded corners and a slight hover effect for interactivity.

Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, likely leveraging GSAP, where elements fade in and slide up into view as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic loading experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual anchors, complemented by a lighter weight sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are applied consistently to buttons, cards, and UI elements, softening the overall aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing throughout, with a more airy feel in the hero section and a slightly denser, but still readable, layout in feature grids and footers.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the highly detailed and interactive UI illustration in the hero section, which appears to be a complex, layered animation or video that responds to scroll. This immediately communicates the product's sophistication and functionality in a visually engaging way, moving beyond a static screenshot or simple animation.
